title: 第21章 其实做仆役也是很香的第22章 二公子
slug: 刚穿越就继承了宗主之位
lines: 一连五天，邱执事都被白天带走，晚上送了回来。每次回来，邱执事都是鼻青脸肿，但是受伤不重，休息一晚就好。
十长老那冰冷的心都被邱执事的精神感动了，受到这样的虐待竟然还不屈服，不愧是血杀走出来的人。
第六天，邱执事如往常一样被分到练功房，这次他很干脆的跪了下来，“大人，我愿意做仆役，我愿意扫地，只要不让我做陪练就成。”
“咦，师尊还说你很硬气，让我不要手下留情。”万尘神情鄙视地说道。
邱执事心说我也很想硬气，可是再这么陪练下去，自己就是不被折磨死，也要被气死。与陪练相比，还不如去扫地了。
邱执事眼巴巴地盯着归海一刀，秦叶基本不来这里，而教导秦叶修炼的是归海一刀。
归海一刀也没有想到邱执事跪的这么干脆，看他这样子再继续下去，道心都崩溃了。
一直关注这里的秦叶，传音给归海一刀：“让他去厨房给吴老头做下手，吴老头这两天一直抱怨让我帮他找个人，就让他去吧。”
“宗主，他毕竟是血杀杀手。”归海一刀提醒道。
“没事，他翻不起什么风浪。至于陪练，不是还有一个人吗？就让他来，刚好万尘要突破先天了，让他做陪练非常合适。”秦叶传音道。
正在悠哉悠哉烤鱼的秦叶，呵呵一笑，有吴老头在，别说他修为被封了，即使没有被封，也掀不起什么风浪。
归海一刀带着邱执事去了厨房，见到吴老头正在忙，对其说道：“宗主让我给你送过来一个人，给你做下手。”
“好嘞，谢谢宗主。”吴老头呵呵笑道。
“此人是血杀杀手，修为被封了，有什么重活可以都让他做，不用对他客气。”归海一刀提醒道。
“小老儿知道了。”吴老头还是一副笑眯眯的样子。
归海一刀深深的看看了他一眼，就走了。
当归海一刀走了后，吴老头一掌按在邱执事的肩膀上，呵呵说道：“以后这里就要多多麻烦小哥了。”
邱执事脸色连续变换，低着头，哭丧着脸说道：“小人应该的。”
此刻，邱执事内心翻腾不已，这厨房的老头竟然也是一位先天境界的强者，刚刚吴老头轻轻拍他肩膀其实是给了他下马威。
当十长老被带到练功房后，彻底崩溃了。邱执事不是说打死他，也不会屈服吗？这才几天的功夫，他就已经屈服了。
这个狗东西！
十长老心恨恨地骂道。
有了十长老做陪练，万尘进步神速，当天晚上就成功突破到先天。
而没过多久，武萱儿也成功突破了一境界。
对于两人的修炼速度，秦叶非常满意，一个先天境界，一个炼体八重境界，这几天两人的努力他看在眼里，非常欣慰。
作为一个欣欣向荣的宗门，弟子就该这么努力。
次日，秦叶将众人召集到大殿内。
秦叶的目光扫视着众人，开口说道：“宗门排名大赛明天开始了，所以中午我们就要出发了，你们就去准备一番吧。”
此次，秦叶只带武萱儿与万尘两个人去，其他人都留在清风宗。
content_en:
For five consecutive days, Deacon Qiu was taken away during the day and sent back at night. Every time he came back, Deacon Qiu had a bruised nose and face, but his injuries were not serious and he could just rest for a night.
The tenth elder's cold heart was touched by Deacon Qiu's spirit. He did not give in despite such abuse. He was worthy of being a man who came out of a bloodbath.
On the sixth day, Deacon Qiu was assigned to the practice room as usual. This time he knelt down simply and said, "Sir, I am willing to be a servant and sweep the floor, as long as I am not allowed to be a sparring partner."
"Hey, Master also said that you are very tough and told me not to be merciful." Wan Chen said with contempt.
"(.﹏.)."
Deacon Qiu said to himself that I also want to be tough, but if I continue to sparring like this, I will be angry to death even if I am not tortured to death. Compared with being a sparring partner, he might as well be sweeping the floor.
Deacon Qiu stared at Guihai Yida eagerly. Qin Ye basically didn't come here, and it was Guihai Yida who taught Qin Ye how to practice.
Gui Hai Yi Dao never thought that Deacon Qiu would kneel down so easily. Seeing him continue like this, Dao's heart collapsed.
Qin Ye, who had been paying attention to this place, sent a message to Gui Hai: "Let him go to the kitchen to do something for Old Man Wu. Old Man Wu has been complaining for the past two days and asked me to find someone for him, so just let him go."
"Sect Master, he is a bloody killer after all." Gui Hai Yi Dao reminded.
"It's okay, he can't make any trouble. As for the sparring partner, isn't there someone else? Just let him come. It just so happens that Wan Chen is about to break through the innateness, so it is very suitable for him to be the sparring partner." Qin Ye said in a message.
Qin Ye, who was leisurely grilling fish, chuckled. With Old Man Wu here, let alone his cultivation being banned, even if he wasn't banned, he wouldn't be able to make any waves.
Guihai Yidao took Deacon Qiu to the kitchen. When he saw Old Man Wu busy, he said to him: "The sect master asked me to send you someone to do something for you."
"Okay, thank you, Master." Old Man Wu chuckled.
"This man is a blood-killing killer, and his cultivation has been banned. You can let him do any heavy work, and you don't have to be polite to him." Gui Hai reminded him with a knife.
"I know, little old man." Old Man Wu was still smiling.
Gui Hai took a deep look at him and left.
After Guihai left with a knife, Old Man Wu put his palm on Deacon Qiu's shoulder and said hehe, "Brother, there will be a lot of trouble here from now on."
Deacon Qiu's face changed continuously, he lowered his head and said with a sad face: "This is what a villain should do."
At this moment, Deacon Qiu's heart was churning. The old man in the kitchen turned out to be a strong man in the innate realm. The old man Wu's gentle pat on his shoulder just now was actually a threat to him.
When the ten elders were taken to the practice room, they completely collapsed. Didn’t Deacon Qiu refuse to give in even if he was beaten to death? After only a few days, he had already succumbed.
This piece of shit!
The tenth elder cursed bitterly.
With the ten elders as sparring partners, Wan Chen made rapid progress and successfully broke through to Xiantian that night.
Not long after, Wu Xuan'er also successfully broke through to a new level.
Qin Ye was very satisfied with the two people's cultivation speed. One was at the innate realm and the other was at the eighth level of body refining. He saw the efforts of the two of them in the past few days and was very pleased.
As a prosperous sect, disciples should work hard like this.
The next day, Qin Ye summoned everyone to the hall.
Qin Ye glanced at everyone and said: "The sect ranking competition will start tomorrow, so we will set off at noon, so you go and prepare."
This time, Qin Ye only took Wu Xuan'er and Wan Chen with him, while the others stayed in Qingfeng Sect.
